sentence: In Arabic the service names on the option cards, the consent screen and the ticket, and the clinic's name, contact and read list, have no Latin letter; in English they are the sample names; and switching language shows the other language's names

Decline moves the ticket to declined and says the clinic can still read what was shared until the person stops sharing, with a link to that control; the clinic can still read it until they do, and cannot after
"I don't want this any more" on the day-7 check declines the ticket with the same words, the same link and the same effect on what the clinic can read
/consent and /ticket redirect to /crisis while the block is set
The consent screen shows every optional element off, the ticket as needed, the equity opt-in off, sends nothing before Send, and previews what the clinic will see
The consent screen disables Send and says so when the service the person chose is not in the directory, and sends nothing; with the service back it can send
The request carries only the ticked elements, and the stored bundle is ciphertext holding only those
Stopping one element removes only it from the stored bundle; withdrawing deletes the bundle and moves the ticket to withdrawn
A summary draft is shared only after the person edits and approves it, and the approved and draft versions are logged as ciphertext
The day-7 check appears from ticket data, and Yes on an issued ticket reaches seen
Not yet leads to other options and a new consent; the child bundle holds only what the new consent allows
Delete everything revokes on the server before wiping, and when the server cannot be reached with data on it, deletes nothing
Delete everything wipes offline, with no request, when nothing was ever shared
Delete everything during an open crisis sends the unsent crisis record first, then wipes, and says so
Delete everything during an open crisis with no network deletes the unsent record with the rest, and says so
Choosing a clinic option and leaving the consent screen unsent keeps the support the person is already on
When the phone refuses to save a change on the options screen, the person is told
Settings names the plain-text crisis note in the tab, and the note holds only the trigger, an id and the time
The consent and ticket screens hold the plan's type, tap-target and no-overflow rules at 390 px
After a reroute the earlier ticket can be opened from the ticket tab and withdrawn, and the old clinic then reads 410
Stopping an element removes the approved summary and its logs and says so, and unticking an element a draft used clears its approval
An element unticked before Approve and ticked again before Send is still in the stored list of what the summary was built from, so a later stop removes the summary
A summary that is the fill-in template, written by the person, is built from nothing: unticking an element does not unapprove it and stopping an element leaves it, its own record and the notice alone
The draft request carries no content with the AI box unticked, and only ticked elements with it ticked
The equity opt-in shows as on once given and can be turned off in Settings, which clears it on the server
The ticket shows who opened it, and says it could not be loaded rather than that nobody did
A refused save around choosing or sending is shown and never leaves the screen stuck, and a referral already sent is not hidden by a failed local write
A withdrawn ticket shows no open steps and no dangling separator, and a 7-day promise reads 7 days on the day it is issued
Preferences and equity options read in the person's language, and directory text sets its own direction
The consent screen matches its committed snapshot at 390 x 844
The ticket screen matches its committed snapshot at 390 x 844, with the code and QR masked
Approving a summary while an element it used is unticked keeps the approval, a hand-written summary is never unapproved by a tick, and the element is absent from what is stored
After a send whose local note failed, the ticket tab finds the ticket from the server's list; a failed list is an error, and a phone that never shared makes no request

Reminders are off until the person turns them on, come every 4 weeks to start and every 2 weeks if chosen, and a due one shows on the home screen in the reminder words alone until the next check-in is finished

The number for text reminders is optional, refused unless international, held by the server only as ciphertext in its own row, labelled a sample, and deleted by removing it, by turning reminders off and by Delete everything
The repeat check is offered on the ticket exactly six weeks after the clinic saw the person and not a minute before, and its screen says when it opens until then

The repeat check ends on the two totals with the box to send them to the clinic unticked; finishing without it sends no totals, ticking it sends exactly the two totals and no answers, and a share the person ended offers nothing to tick
An answer above zero to item 9 of the repeat PHQ-9 opens the crisis screen as in any check-in, and the repeat check screen is then closed to the person until the crisis is resolved
The person's control to end a seen ticket moves it from seen to closed with the person as actor, and nothing is offered to end a ticket that has not been seen

The repeat check starts a fresh PHQ-9 at question 1 even when an unfinished one from before the clinic saw the person is on the phone, and both start links, and the link to the GAD-7, carry the exact moment the check opened

A day after the person releases a crisis screen, and not a minute before, home carries a neutral "how are you today" card and the next-day screen asks how they are; both work with the network cut, a worse answer puts Help now first and offers a GP or specialist, and the answer stays on the phone and nothing is written to the server
The next-day offer leads into the ordinary flow: the options screen matches on the phone, a fresh check-in reaches the consent screen, and a new crisis sends the next-day screen to the crisis screen
